label: EU-ehds-2025 Article 18

obligations.text:
Compensation for making personal electronic health data available
Providers receiving data under this Chapter shall not be required to compensate the healthcare provider for making personal electronic health data available.
A healthcare provider or a third party shall not directly or indirectly charge data subjects a fee or costs, or require compensation, for sharing or accessing data.
